edits.old: Then the work order leaves through the rwb-partner contract and the step publishes no event
edits.new:
Then the work order leaves through the rwb-partner contract and the step publishes no event

  Scenario: AC6 Error answers of the provided operations (no legacy origin; added by this story)
    Given the provided operations of section 12 are called
    Then a request with no valid credential is answered 401
    Then a request by a role that lacks the right is answered 403
    Then a request for an asset outside the scope or not found is answered 404

  Scenario: AC7 Replay of a write with the same idempotency key (no legacy origin; added by this story)
    Given the cost write of section 12 has been accepted once with its idempotency_key
    When the same write is replayed with the same idempotency_key
    Then the first answer is returned and no second cost is written

  Scenario: AC8 Activity retry and timeout (no legacy origin; added by this story)
    Given the rwb-partner contract mock does not answer within 2 s
    When the work order is raised
    Then the work order stays at "ASSET_HELD", an outbox retry runs and no cost is released

  Scenario: AC9 A consumed call fails (no legacy origin; added by this story)
    Given the rwb-decision contract mock returns no rule package in force at the version the decision record names
    When the action is taken
    Then the step stops and nothing changes

  Scenario: AC10 A status change the model does not allow is refused (no legacy origin; added by this story)
    Given the rwb-case contract mock returns a case state other than "ASSET_HELD" for "RC-2026-000512"
    When the work order is raised
    Then the work order is refused, the state is reported and no cost is written

edits.old: AC4 is added by this story for exception X2, which section 5 covered only by the access case; it has no legacy origin and is tested by TC-E3-025-04. AC5 is added by this story for the cross-service limits of BR7 to BR11 and is tested by TC-E3-025-06 and TC-E3-025-07.
edits.new: AC4 is added by this story for exception X2, which section 5 covered only by the access case; it has no legacy origin and is tested by TC-E3-025-04. AC5 is added by this story for the cross-service limits of BR7 to BR11 and is tested by TC-E3-025-06 and TC-E3-025-07. AC6 to AC10 are added by this story for the error answers, the replay of a write, the retry and timeout of an activity, a failed consumed call and a disallowed status change; they are tested by TC-E3-025-09 to TC-E3-025-13.
